profile_text.body:
Submagic is a web-based video editing tool aimed at creators producing short-form content for social media platforms. The company describes its product as a way to edit short videos significantly faster using AI, with the service handling caption generation, b-roll insertion, formatting, and clip highlighting automatically after a video is uploaded.

The core Submagic product sits in the video generation and editing category and is noted as an EU vendor. Its feature set includes auto-subtitle generation, an AI video editor, podcast clip creation, b-roll generation, auto-zoom, sound effects, video translation, and a video-to-text tool. A range of free utilities for creators, covering things like TikTok hashtags, video scripts, and Instagram captions, is also offered alongside the main product.

The held facts record no litigation, no MCP server presence, and no SEC or patent filings associated with the company.
